type.weight: font-medium for all display type and headings, font-semibold only for emphasis in running copy, never font-bold
type.rule: the hero headline is the largest type on the page

colour.rule: one accent on the primary CTA only, repeated at most once elsewhere; sample the accent from the hero-7 shader and keep every other section neutral so the shader stays the only saturated moment

motion.stagger: delay: Math.min(index, 5) * 0.06, a section must finish revealing within 500ms
motion.reducedMotion: add useReducedMotion() and collapse to an opacity-only fade when true; hero-7's shader drops to a static frame or still gradient

blocks.content: Product name, up to three links, one CTA matching the page conversion goal.

config.ctaLabel: match the page-wide CTA label verbatim

blocks.fallback: A fixed 56–64px bar: product name left, 3 links, one action right.

blocks.content: Product name or one-idea statement, a one-sentence subhead naming the audience, a status line (launch date or availability), the primary CTA, and one real product visual.

config.actions: one primary CTA plus one text link

blocks.fallback: Full-viewport hero: headline, subhead, status line, CTA, product image.

blocks.content: Real, recognisable customer logos or linked press mentions. Remove this block entirely if none exist.
blocks.fallback: A single row of linked press mentions in caption-size text.

blocks.content: The product's single strongest claim as one headline and one supporting visual.
blocks.fallback: A full-viewport statement section: one headline, one visual, no body copy.

blocks.content: Three to five capabilities as alternating text/visual rows. Outcome headline, one-to-two sentence mechanism, one visual each.

config.layout: alternating text/visual, never a card grid

blocks.fallback: Stacked two-column rows alternating text and visual sides.

blocks.content: Three or four real numbers with units and short labels. Remove this block if the numbers are not real.
blocks.fallback: A hairline-separated row of three numbers with captions.

blocks.content: Pre-launch: what waitlist members receive and when. Shipping now: setup or rollout in three steps.
blocks.fallback: Three hairline-separated rows describing the sequence.

blocks.content: Email capture only. State what the visitor receives, when, and the anti-spam promise.
blocks.fallback: A single-field email form with a submit button and a one-line promise.

blocks.content: Real prices and real limits, with plain-text answers on trial end, card requirement, and cancellation.

config.variant: use for launch status = shipping now

blocks.fallback: A hairline-separated pricing table stating each tier's binding limit.

blocks.content: Five to eight real questions including availability, refunds/cancellation, data handling, and the comparison to the obvious alternative.
blocks.fallback: A keyboard-operable disclosure list of questions and answers.

blocks.content: Restate the offer with new information: a date, a limit, or a guarantee. Never a copy of the hero.

config.ctaLabel: match the page-wide CTA label verbatim

blocks.fallback: A tall closing section: one line, one button, one friction-reducing caption.

blocks.content: Legal, contact, status, and social links. Real destinations only.
blocks.fallback: A small-type footer with grouped links and a legal line.
